name: setfsuid
description: setfsuid() sets the filesystem user ID of the calling process, which is used for permissions checking when accessing filesystem objects. It allows the filesystem user ID to differ from the effective user ID, typically for specific applications like NFS servers.

parameters.name: fsuid
parameters.description: The new value for the filesystem user ID

return_value.success: Returns the previous filesystem user ID of the caller
return_value.failure: Also returns the previous filesystem user ID of the caller

bugs: No error indications of any kind are returned to the caller, and both successful and unsuccessful calls return the same value, making it impossible to directly determine whether the call succeeded or failed.
